visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long brown hair wearing a green t-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor office space with large windows and gray curtains. He holds a red Pizza Hut box and whispers towards the camera, looking directly at the lens. (2) The same man sits on the floor next to a large green Uber Eats delivery bag. He holds a smartphone, scrolling through an Instagram following list. The lighting is bright and even. (3) On a sunny outdoor street, the man wears a white motorcycle helmet. He runs in a comical, exaggerated crouching manner towards a girl walking with a black umbrella. He stuffs a pizza box into her arms and runs away. (4) Back indoors, the man is shown lying on a blue ping pong table, still holding the phone and delivery bag. He repeats the scrolling action to find a new target. (5) Transition to an urban exterior near a building with glass windows. The man wears the helmet and a black mask. He approaches a male target (Chuchushoe) and asks for an autograph on a pizza box before fleeing. (6) The man is seen crawling on a wooden floor inside a studio environment filled with shelves and equipment. He wears the white helmet and white t-shirt now, moving stealthily toward an office area. (7) He enters a room where a man is working at a multi-monitor desk. He carefully places the pizza on the side of the desk while remaining on the floor. (8) A series of close-up shots show various Pizza Hut pizzas, sides like fried dough balls, and Pepsi cans arranged on a table. Promotional text overlays appear. (9) The creator returns to a medium shot, speaking enthusiastically to the camera, holding a small green Uber Eats anniversary cake toy.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-frequency, soft whisper from a male speaker. There is a noticeable dry room tone with minimal reverb. No music is present in this initial phase. (2) A sharp transition occurs with a 'pop' sound effect as high-tempo electronic music with a strong synthesizer lead and 4/4 drum beat enters. The male voice becomes normal in volume and excited in tone. (3) A 'clink' sound of a motorcycle helmet visor triggers a transition to stealth-like orchestral music with pizzicato strings. Background urban ambient noise (faint wind and distance traffic) is audible. (4) Rapid camera shutter sound effects punctuate visual cuts during the target selection phase. The BGM maintains its high tempo. (5) Mechanical writing sounds of a marker on cardboard are heard as the speaker interacts with another male. The music swells slightly in volume. (6) Low-frequency rustling sounds of clothing and knee-dragging on a floor accompany the stealth crawling phase. The 'Metal Gear Solid' alert sound effect plays briefly. (7) A loud 'whoosh' transition leads into the promotional finale. Upbeat pop music with bright synthesizers accompanies a fast-paced, professional advertising narration with multiple 'ding' UI sound effects.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Uber Eats' 9th Anniversary campaign and specific Pizza Hut discounts. It uses a comedic 'stealth delivery' challenge as a creative hook to engage viewers before transitioning into a direct promotional segment detailing offers and limited-edition merchandise.
